note: GRATUS MODELS. Emojis kept together on the same day, three days over, become a model: a small, named pattern of how something grows, gets built, begins, pays, coordinates, or heals. The formula is the emojis; the result is the emoji the model gives you, planted in your field; the statement is the law; the loop is the mechanism in one line. Statements are plain and the owner may refine any of them.

models.name: Compound Morning
models.statement: Small daily input, kept, becomes a capacity.
models.loop: input every day → capacity → better input

models.name: Seed and Water
models.statement: Attention is the water. What you attend to grows.

models.name: Slow Sun
models.statement: Growth follows the light you give it, on its own schedule.

models.name: Walk It Off
models.statement: A walk turns weight into ground.

models.name: The Long Book
models.statement: Reading at night rewrites the morning.

models.name: Body First
models.statement: Fuel, then effort, then rest.

models.name: Practice Loop
models.statement: Repetition with attention is how skill grows.

models.name: Still Point
models.statement: Stillness widens the channel everything moves through.

models.name: Yearly Ring
models.statement: One ring a year. No shortcut, and no loss.

models.name: Rain to River
models.statement: Hard days gather into a current.

models.name: Brick a Day
models.statement: One brick, kept, is a wall by spring.

models.name: Sketch Then Build
models.statement: Draw it before you build it.

models.name: Keystone
models.statement: Find the piece the rest depend on. Place it first.

models.name: The Workshop
models.statement: A place for the work makes the work happen.

models.name: Blueprint
models.statement: Notes with an aim become a plan.

models.name: Thread and Needle
models.statement: Small joins make strong cloth.

models.name: Fix It
models.statement: A repair is an idea with its hands dirty.

models.name: Ship It
models.statement: Share it before it is perfect.

models.name: Foundation
models.statement: What you build on decides what you can build.

models.name: Sharp Tools
models.statement: Care for the tool and the tool cares for you.

models.name: First Light
models.statement: An idea is a morning. Get up.

models.name: Two Founders
models.statement: An idea with a hand in it can stand.

models.name: Ask Ten People
models.statement: Ask ten people before you plan.

models.name: Smallest Thing
models.statement: Build the smallest piece that proves the whole.

models.name: Runway
models.statement: Time is the runway. Money only buys time.

models.name: Pivot
models.statement: When the map is wrong, turn. Keep the compass.

models.name: Word of Mouth
models.statement: A gift told twice is a market.

models.name: Launch Day
models.statement: A launch is a beginning wearing a party hat.

models.name: Night Shift
models.statement: The quiet hours build what the loud hours sell.

models.name: Founder's Rest
models.statement: Rest is part of the sprint.

models.name: Value First
models.statement: Give value first. Money is the echo.

models.name: Counted
models.statement: What you count, you can keep.

models.name: Set Aside
models.statement: A tenth, set aside, becomes what you lean on.
models.loop: set aside → grow → lean → set aside

models.name: Fair Scale
models.statement: A fair deal is repeated. An unfair one is remembered.

models.name: Return Customer
models.statement: Loved once, returned twice. Profit is return.

models.name: Plain Price
models.statement: Price it plainly.

models.name: Slow Money
models.statement: Money that took time stays.

models.name: The Tab
models.statement: Bread today, bread tomorrow. That is the whole ledger.

models.name: Split
models.statement: Share the upside and the upside grows.

models.name: Enough
models.statement: Knowing enough is the largest profit.

models.name: Common Ground
models.statement: Keep the same thing, both accept it. That is a team.

models.name: Same Page
models.statement: Put the plan in one line everyone sees.

models.name: The Call
models.statement: A call closes distance faster than a plan.

models.name: Circle
models.statement: Return to the same people on purpose.

models.name: Handoff
models.statement: Pass it on cleanly and it keeps moving.

models.name: Bridge
models.statement: Two shores need one span. Be the span.

models.name: One Bell
models.statement: One signal everyone hears saves a hundred messages.

models.name: Shared Table
models.statement: Eat together. Decide after.

models.name: Open Door
models.statement: An open door is a rule that needs no meeting.

models.name: Two Yeses
models.statement: Nothing shared without two yeses.

models.name: Kept Light
models.statement: Thanks and a candle, kept, become morning.

models.name: Rest Is Growth
models.statement: Rest is also growth.

models.name: Held
models.statement: Fear, with a hand in it, loosens.

models.name: Named
models.statement: A feeling named is a feeling held.

models.name: The Walk Home
models.statement: The way home is part of the day.

models.name: Repair
models.statement: Hurt and thanks in the same day: that is repair.

models.name: Tend the Person
models.statement: Tend the person, not just the feeling.

models.name: Present
models.statement: The ground asks if you're here. You answer with a touch.

models.name: Given Hands
models.statement: Thanks, with hands, reaches the world.

models.name: Morning After
models.statement: Every hard night has a morning after it.

recipes.name: The Long Light
recipes.statement: Growth is ordinary light, applied for longer than it stays interesting.
recipes.loop: A small input kept up every day compounds past the point where effort and result still look related.

recipes.name: The Night School
recipes.statement: What you return to in the quiet is what you actually become.
recipes.loop: Attention given when nobody is watching sets the direction the rest of the day inherits.

recipes.name: Luck Surface
recipes.statement: Luck is a surface area, and moving makes it bigger.
recipes.loop: More attempts put you in contact with more chance, and chance only ever reaches things already in motion.

recipes.name: The Honest Mirror
recipes.statement: You cannot steer by a story you are protecting.
recipes.loop: Saying the real thing out loud to one person turns a feeling into a direction you can walk.

recipes.name: The Small Hammer
recipes.statement: A thing built in an hour a day outlives a thing built in a weekend.
recipes.loop: Short sessions keep the whole shape in your head, and a shape you can hold is a shape you can finish.

recipes.name: The First Brick
recipes.statement: The first brick is not the hardest. The second one, on an ordinary Tuesday, is.
recipes.loop: Starting runs on excitement and excitement expires; continuing runs on a decision already made.

recipes.name: The Sharpened Axe
recipes.statement: Time spent on the tool is not time taken from the work.
recipes.loop: Every improvement to how you work is paid back by everything you do afterwards, forever.

recipes.name: Load Bearing
recipes.statement: Find the one wall holding the roof up, and treat it differently from the others.
recipes.loop: Most parts of a system can fail quietly. Naming the one that cannot is most of the engineering.

recipes.name: One True User
recipes.statement: One person who would be upset if it vanished beats a thousand who would shrug.
recipes.loop: Depth of need is measurable and breadth is not, so build for the person you can actually hear.

recipes.name: The Smallest Door
recipes.statement: Make the first step so small that refusing it takes more effort than doing it.
recipes.loop: Adoption is lost at the threshold, not at the feature list. Lower the threshold and the list gets read.

recipes.name: Told Twice
recipes.statement: You do not have a thing until somebody explains it to somebody else, correctly, without you.
recipes.loop: A message survives a retelling only when it is simple, and only a message that survives retelling travels.

recipes.name: The Boring Rail
recipes.statement: Put the excitement in what you make, never in what you make it on.
recipes.loop: Dull, proven foundations spend none of your attention, which leaves all of it for the part only you can do.

recipes.name: The Honest Price
recipes.statement: A price that embarrasses you is a price that will not survive a hard year.
recipes.loop: Charging what a thing is worth funds the care it needs; charging less quietly withdraws that care later.

recipes.name: The Second Sale
recipes.statement: The first sale is persuasion. The second is proof.
recipes.loop: Everything true about a product shows up in whether the same person comes a second time.

recipes.name: Own The Rail
recipes.statement: Whoever owns the road takes a toll from everything that travels it.
recipes.loop: Value settles where the flow is constrained, so build near the constraint or accept somebody else’s toll.

recipes.name: Give First
recipes.statement: Generosity that costs you something is the only kind anybody notices.
recipes.loop: A real gift creates an obligation nobody asked for and everybody feels, and it keeps growing on its own.

recipes.name: One Throat
recipes.statement: A decision with two owners has none.
recipes.loop: Naming the single person who decides converts an argument into a choice that can actually be made.

recipes.name: The Shared Map
recipes.statement: Most disagreements are two people describing different maps in the same words.
recipes.loop: Drawing the thing you are both talking about ends more arguments than any amount of talking about it.

recipes.name: The Slow Yes
recipes.statement: A fast yes and a slow no cost the same, and one of them is a lie.
recipes.loop: Saying no early returns time to both people; saying yes late spends it twice and buys resentment.

recipes.name: Written Down
recipes.statement: A thing that was only ever said was only ever half agreed.
recipes.loop: Writing it down finds the disagreement while it is still cheap, which is the entire point of writing it down.

recipes.name: Held, Not Fixed
recipes.statement: Most pain is asking to be witnessed, not solved.
recipes.loop: Offering a solution answers a question nobody asked; staying answers the one they did.

recipes.name: Own Oxygen
recipes.statement: You cannot pour from a cup you keep refusing to fill.
recipes.loop: Rest is not the reward for care, it is the input, and skipping the input eventually stops the output.

recipes.name: The Small Return
recipes.statement: The message you almost did not send is usually the one that lands.
recipes.loop: Low-effort contact, repeated, keeps a relationship alive far better than rare and heavy contact.

recipes.name: The Long Thread
recipes.statement: What you keep returning to is what you are actually loving.
recipes.loop: Love is not felt once and stored; it is a thread pulled through many ordinary days and it shows in the count.
